approved: Moved a debate management motion limiting consideration of the four fuel indexation bills to a set process, including capping the detail stage at 30 minutes, to ensure the government's fuel excise legislation passes that day.

Supported the fuel indexation bill as part of the government's election commitments, contrasting the opposition's opposition to a 0.4 cent fuel excise rise with what he said would have been a 6.85 cent per litre carbon tax on diesel under Labor, and cited a $50 billion road package over the next decade.
